units.locator: Article 23.25. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Protection and Use of Specially Protected Natural Areas
units.text: 1) the Chief State Inspector of the Russian Federation for Environmental Protection and his or her deputies;

units.locator: Article 23.25. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Protection and Use of Specially Protected Natural Areas
units.text: 2) chief state inspectors for environmental protection for constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.25

units.locator: Article 23.25. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Protection and Use of Specially Protected Natural Areas
units.text: 3) chief state inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for environmental protection and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.25

units.locator: Article 23.25. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Protection and Use of Specially Protected Natural Areas
units.text: 4) repealed. — Federal Law of 14.10.2014 No. 307-FZ;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.25

units.locator: Article 23.25. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Protection and Use of Specially Protected Natural Areas
units.text: 5) heads of state institutions managing specially protected natural areas of federal significance — chief state inspectors for environmental protection in specially protected natural areas of federal significance — and their deputies;

units.locator: Article 23.25. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Protection and Use of Specially Protected Natural Areas
units.text: 6) heads of state institutions subordinate to executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation managing specially protected natural areas — chief state inspectors for environmental protection in specially protected natural areas of regional significance — and their deputies.

units.locator: Article 23.26. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection, Reproduction and Use of Wildlife and Its Habitats
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.26. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection, Reproduction and Use of Wildlife and Its Habitats
units.label: Art. 23.26

units.locator: Article 23.26. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection, Reproduction and Use of Wildlife and Its Habitats
units.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising federal state supervision in the field of protection, reproduction and use of wildlife and its habitats shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 7.2 (concerning destruction of or damage to signs installed by wildlife users or authorities exercising federal state supervision in the field of protection, reproduction and use of wildlife and its habitats, and to buildings and other structures belonging to those users and authorities, except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas), part 1 of Article 7.11 (except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas), Article 8.29 (within their powers), Article 8.33 (except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas), Article 8.34 (with respect to administrative offences involving biological collections containing wildlife, except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas), Article 8.35 (except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas), Article 8.36 (except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas), parts 1 and 1.1 of Article 8.37 (except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas), and part 3 of Article 8.37 (except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.26

units.locator: Article 23.26. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection, Reproduction and Use of Wildlife and Its Habitats
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.26

units.locator: Article 23.26. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection, Reproduction and Use of Wildlife and Its Habitats
units.text: 1) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising federal state supervision in the field of protection, reproduction and use of wildlife and its habitats and their deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.26

units.locator: Article 23.26. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection, Reproduction and Use of Wildlife and Its Habitats
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising federal state supervision in the field of protection, reproduction and use of wildlife and its habitats and their deputies.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.26

units.locator: Article 23.26.1. Authorities and Institutions Exercising Federal State Hunting Control (Supervision)
units.text: 1. Authorities and institutions exercising federal state hunting control (supervision) shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 7.2 (concerning destruction of or damage to signs installed by wildlife users or authorities exercising federal state control (supervision) in the field of protection, reproduction and use of wildlife and its habitats, as well as to buildings and other structures belonging to those users and authorities), part 1 of Article 7.11, Article 8.29 (within their powers), Article 8.33, Article 8.34 (with respect to administrative offences involving biological collections containing wildlife), Article 8.35 (within their powers), Article 8.36, and parts 1, 1.1 and 3 of Article 8.37 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.26.1

units.locator: Article 23.26.1. Authorities and Institutions Exercising Federal State Hunting Control (Supervision)
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities and institutions specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.26.1

units.locator: Article 23.26.1. Authorities and Institutions Exercising Federal State Hunting Control (Supervision)
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority of the Russian Federation exercising federal state hunting control (supervision) and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.26.1

units.locator: Article 23.26.1. Authorities and Institutions Exercising Federal State Hunting Control (Supervision)
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority of the Russian Federation exercising federal state hunting control (supervision) and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.26.1

units.locator: Article 23.26.1. Authorities and Institutions Exercising Federal State Hunting Control (Supervision)
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority of the Russian Federation exercising federal state hunting control (supervision) and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.26.1

units.locator: Article 23.26.1. Authorities and Institutions Exercising Federal State Hunting Control (Supervision)
units.text: 4) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising federal state hunting control (supervision) and their deputies;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.26.1

units.locator: Article 23.26.1. Authorities and Institutions Exercising Federal State Hunting Control (Supervision)
units.text: 5) heads of structural divisions of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising federal state hunting control (supervision) and their deputies;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.26.1

units.locator: Article 23.26.1. Authorities and Institutions Exercising Federal State Hunting Control (Supervision)
units.text: 6) heads of federal state budgetary institutions exercising federal state hunting control (supervision) and their deputies;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 23.26.1

units.locator: Article 23.26.1. Authorities and Institutions Exercising Federal State Hunting Control (Supervision)
units.text: 7) heads of state budgetary institutions of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising federal state hunting control (supervision) and their deputies.
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 23.26.1

units.label: Art. 23.27

units.locator: Article 23.27. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Fisheries and Conservation of Aquatic Biological Resources
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the field of fisheries and conservation of aquatic biological resources shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 7.2 (concerning destruction of or damage to signs installed by wildlife users or the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the field of fisheries and conservation of aquatic biological resources, as well as to buildings and other structures belonging to those users and that authority), part 1 of Article 7.11, Article 8.29 (within its powers), Article 8.33 (with respect to violation of the rules for protecting the habitats or migration routes of aquatic biological resources, except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas of federal significance), Article 8.34 (with respect to administrative offences involving biological collections containing wildlife classified as aquatic biological resources, except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas of federal significance), Article 8.35 (with respect to administrative offences involving rare and endangered aquatic biological resources listed in the Red Data Book of the Russian Federation and/or protected by international treaties of the Russian Federation, except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas of federal significance), Article 8.36 (with respect to wildlife classified as aquatic biological resources, except those inhabiting specially protected natural areas of federal significance), parts 2 and 3 of Article 8.37, Articles 8.38 and 8.39 (with respect to violation of the rules for the protection and use of aquatic biological resources, except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas of federal significance), part 1 of Article 8.42, Article 8.48 (except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas of federal significance), Article 11.6 (with respect to administrative offences committed on vessels and at facilities of the fishing fleet), parts 1 and 1.1 of Article 11.7, Articles 11.8 and 11.9 - 11.11, and part 2 of Article 11.17 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.27

units.locator: Article 23.27. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Fisheries and Conservation of Aquatic Biological Resources
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.27

units.locator: Article 23.27. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Fisheries and Conservation of Aquatic Biological Resources
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the field of fisheries and conservation of aquatic biological resources and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.27

units.locator: Article 23.27. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Fisheries and Conservation of Aquatic Biological Resources
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the field of fisheries and conservation of aquatic biological resources and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.27

units.locator: Article 23.27. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Fisheries and Conservation of Aquatic Biological Resources
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the field of fisheries and conservation of aquatic biological resources and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.27

units.locator: Article 23.27. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Fisheries and Conservation of Aquatic Biological Resources
units.text: 4) heads of departments, deputy heads of departments, chief and senior state inspectors of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the field of fisheries and conservation of aquatic biological resources.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.27

units.locator: Article 23.28. Federal Executive Authority in the Field of Hydrometeorology and Related Fields

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.28. Federal Executive Authority in the Field of Hydrometeorology and Related Fields
units.label: Art. 23.28

units.locator: Article 23.28. Federal Executive Authority in the Field of Hydrometeorology and Related Fields
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority in the field of hydrometeorology and related fields shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 7.2 (concerning destruction of or damage to stationary stations for observing the state of the environment and its pollution that form part of the state observation network, as well as violations of the regime of their protection zones), and Articles 8.5, 8.40 and 8.43 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.28

units.locator: Article 23.28. Federal Executive Authority in the Field of Hydrometeorology and Related Fields
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.28

units.locator: Article 23.28. Federal Executive Authority in the Field of Hydrometeorology and Related Fields
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority in the field of hydrometeorology and related fields and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.28

units.locator: Article 23.28. Federal Executive Authority in the Field of Hydrometeorology and Related Fields
units.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority and their deputies.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.28

units.locator: Article 23.29. Authorities Exercising State Environmental Supervision
units.text: 1. Authorities exercising state environmental supervision shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 7.2 (concerning destruction of or damage to signs of specially protected natural areas, as well as signs installed by wildlife users or authorities exercising federal state supervision in the field of protection, reproduction and use of wildlife and its habitats, and buildings and other structures belonging to those users and authorities), Article 7.6, part 1 of Article 7.11, Articles 8.1, 8.2, 8.2.1, 8.2.2, 8.2.3, 8.4, 8.5, 8.5.1 and 8.5.3, Articles 8.6 and 8.7 (except administrative offences committed on agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land'), Article 8.12 (with respect to violation of the procedure for allocating land plots in water protection zones and coastal strips of water bodies), parts 1, 2 and 4 of Article 8.13, part 1 of Article 8.14, Article 8.15, parts 1 and 3 of Article 8.17, Articles 8.18, 8.19 and 8.21 - 8.23, Article 8.29 (within their powers), parts 2 and 3 of Article 8.31, Articles 8.33 - 8.36, part 3 of Article 8.37, Articles 8.39, 8.41, 8.41.1, 8.46, 8.47, 8.50, 8.51 and 8.55, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, parts 38 - 41 of Article 19.5, and Article 19.7.16 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.29

units.locator: Article 23.29. Authorities Exercising State Environmental Supervision
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.29

units.locator: Article 23.29. Authorities Exercising State Environmental Supervision
units.text: 1) the Chief State Inspector of the Russian Federation for Environmental Protection and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.29

units.locator: Article 23.29. Authorities Exercising State Environmental Supervision
units.text: 2) senior state inspectors of the Russian Federation for environmental protection;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.29

units.locator: Article 23.29. Authorities Exercising State Environmental Supervision
units.text: 3) state inspectors of the Russian Federation for environmental protection;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.29

units.locator: Article 23.29. Authorities Exercising State Environmental Supervision
units.text: 4) chief state inspectors of the Russian Federation for environmental protection within their areas of activity and their deputies;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.29

units.locator: Article 23.29. Authorities Exercising State Environmental Supervision
units.text: 5) senior state inspectors of the Russian Federation for environmental protection within their areas of activity;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.29

units.locator: Article 23.29. Authorities Exercising State Environmental Supervision
units.text: 6) state inspectors of the Russian Federation for environmental protection within their areas of activity;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 23.29

units.locator: Article 23.29. Authorities Exercising State Environmental Supervision
units.text: 7) chief state inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for environmental protection and their deputies;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 23.29

units.locator: Article 23.29. Authorities Exercising State Environmental Supervision
units.text: 8) senior state inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for environmental protection;
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 23.29

units.locator: Article 23.29. Authorities Exercising State Environmental Supervision
units.text: 9) state inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for environmental protection.
units.label: Point 9 Part 2 Art. 23.29

units.locator: Article 23.29. Authorities Exercising State Environmental Supervision
units.text: 3. Repealed. — Federal Law of 14.10.2014 No. 307-FZ.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 23.29

units.locator: Article 23.29. Authorities Exercising State Environmental Supervision
units.text: 4. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.18 and 8.19 of this Code shall be heard by the officials specified in items 1 - 6 of part 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 23.29

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.30. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Energy Supervision
units.label: Art. 23.30

units.locator: Article 23.30. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Energy Supervision
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state energy supervision shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 9.7 - 9.9, Article 9.10 (with respect to damage to heat networks or their equipment), Article 9.11, parts 7 and 8 and part 10 (with respect to administrative offences committed by organisations with state or municipal participation) of Article 9.16, Articles 9.17, 9.18 and 9.19, parts 1 - 6 of Article 9.22, part 6 of Article 9.24, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, and Article 14.61 (with respect to violation of the established procedure for providing security for the performance of obligations to pay for electric energy (capacity), thermal energy (capacity) and/or heat transfer fluid, coupled with failure to perform (improper performance of) the obligations to pay for them) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.30

units.locator: Article 23.30. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Energy Supervision
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.30

units.locator: Article 23.30. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Energy Supervision
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state energy supervision and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.30

units.locator: Article 23.30. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Energy Supervision
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state energy supervision and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.30

units.locator: Article 23.30. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Energy Supervision
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state energy supervision and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.30

units.locator: Article 23.30. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Energy Supervision
units.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state energy supervision and their deputies;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.30

units.locator: Article 23.30. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Energy Supervision
units.text: 5) chief state inspectors, senior state inspectors and state inspectors of the federal executive authority exercising federal state energy supervision;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.30

units.locator: Article 23.30. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Energy Supervision
units.text: 6) chief state inspectors, senior state inspectors and state inspectors of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state energy supervision.
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 23.30

units.locator: Article 23.30. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Energy Supervision
units.text: 3. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 9.9, 9.11, 9.17, 9.18 and 9.19 of this Code shall be heard by the officials specified in items 1 - 4 of part 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 23.30
